fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-05-03, around 00:35, a red auto bearing registration number TN-72-ZZ-1050 used by the complainant for daily work was taken from Sevvanthi Colony Bus Stand Area in Vellore, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-05-05. Uma Raj approached Vellore Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000089. Anand Muthu (9000000280), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. A witness, Ramya Bai, reachable on 9000000232, was mentioned in the complaint. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Potentially relevant material referenced includes physical documents and a vehicle observation.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away after being left unattended.
fields.Keywords: auto theft, vehicle, documents, auto, witness, vehicle observation, bus stand, night
